display_name: The Electricity Industry Act 2010 (NZ) — the supply obligation, the dispute resolution scheme and enforcement limits — under one top-level goal and three goals (billing is in the Participation Code, not the Act)

others: the distributor commits the s 105(4) offence (eia-supply.l4)
must be a member of the dispute resolution scheme (eia-disputes.l4)
the Authority may act on the breach (eia-enforcement.l4)

scope: ss 52, 54(1)(d), 66, 80(2)-(3), 95-96 and 105-107 of the PCO's version as at 30 March 2025, from the text converted from the PCO XML, with Legislation Act 2019 ss 13, 54-56. Retail billing rules are in the Electricity Industry Participation Code 2010, not the Act.

forks.F1: s 107: supply from the day after 6 months running from the day after the notice.
forks.F2: s 52: the day 3 or 10 years earlier is in time.
